subject: Post-call recap — infra gating items for private vs dedicated decision
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medilogix.com>, Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@medilogix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — infra gating items for private vs dedicated decision

Hi Samantha / Paul —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our 45-minute discovery so your security and infra teams have a clear view on what will drive a decision between Redwood Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private (VPC/on-prem). See the attached checklist — I filled in the items we covered and flagged unknowns.

Top takeaways:
- Primary concern: PHI handling and customer-managed keys for encryption at rest. This is the biggest driver toward Private vs Dedicated.
- SSO: You need SAML with SCIM provisioning and strict session expiry controls; ok to use either Dedicated or Private, but Hosted requires extra controls and an enterprise plan.
- KMS/HSM: You indicated requirement for BYOK via HSM-backed keys (FIPS-validated HSM). That generally pushes toward Private (on-prem or VPC with HSM integration) unless we set up an isolated Dedicated pool with KMS peering and strict audit controls.
- Logging & retention: Compliance asks for 7 years of immutable audit logs for access and model inputs; Hosted default retention won't meet that without an add-on.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether BYOK must be HSM-backed (yes/no)?
2) Please share security contact (email) so we can start a short intake and scoping call for Private deployment (if needed).
3) I'll loop in Solutions Engineering to produce a cost delta (Dedicated vs Private) and a timeline estimate.

Attachments: redwood-infra-gating-checklist.xlsx (1 tab with SSO / KMS / logs / data residency rows).

I'll follow up with a short proposal once we have your security contact and the HSM confirmation.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0139

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medilogix.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@medilogix.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — infra gating items for private vs dedicated decision

Aditya — thanks for the summary and the checklist. A couple clarifications from our side before we loop in security: 

1) BYOK / HSM: Our compliance lead says HSM-backed keys are required for anything that holds patient data at rest. We mean a managed HSM (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or equivalent). If Redwood can integrate with our HSM provider (Gemini HSM) in a VPC peered setup, that would be our preference.

2) SSO: We need SAML + SCIM; auto-provisioning is important. Also need the ability to enforce 15-minute idle session timeout via IdP. Can Dedicated support SCIM?

3) Logs: We need immutable audit logs retained for 7 years; they must be exportable to our cloud log archive (S3 with vaulting). If retention requires a separate compliance package, please call that out.

4) Timeline: We're targeting a security review week of Dec 7 — can you commit to providing a draft architecture + integration plan before that week?

If you can answer these 4 points, we can loop in our security lead (Teresa Wong) and one of our infra engineers (cc'd on the next email).

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Platform Engineering | MediLogix Health
Samantha.Ortiz@medilogix.com | +1 212-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medilogix.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — infra gating items for private vs dedicated decision

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Quick technical clarifications from SE: 

- HSM / BYOK: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations for Dedicated when customers bring their own cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) — however, for HSM-backed BYOK with an external vendor (Gemini HSM) we recommend Private VPC or on-prem deployment. Private supports direct HSM peering or colocated HSM appliances.

- SAML + SCIM: Dedicated supports SAML SSO; SCIM provisioning is available on our Dedicated enterprise plan. Hosted can support SAML but SCIM and session-timeout enforcement at the IdP level are enterprise-only features. We'll note the 15-minute idle requirement — SCIM + session policies are achievable on Dedicated or Private.

- Logs & retention: Our standard Hosted retention is 90 days. We can build a long-term export pipeline (to your S3 archive) that writes immutable, versioned logs, but that export is only available on Dedicated or Private with a compliance package. For 7-year immutable retention (with chained integrity), Private (customer-managed storage or vaulting) is the easiest path; Dedicated can meet it with an add-on and SLA.

- Timeline: We can produce a draft architecture + integration plan by Tue, Dec 1 if you share the security contact and HSM vendor contact this week. That will include: proposed network topology (VPC peering or private link), KMS/HSM integration options, SCIM/SAML config, and a retained-logs export design.

Next operational step I suggest: security intake call (30–45m) between Teresa (your security lead), our Solutions Architect (me), and an infra engineer to validate the KMS/HSM feasibility. Aditya — can you propose 2 slots next week?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

On attachments: I also attached the intake form we'll send to security (mld-intake-form.pdf) — filling that out accelerates architecture drafting.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medilogix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — infra gating items for private vs dedicated decision

Samantha — thanks. We're aligned on the ask and can meet the Dec 7 review target. Proposed next steps:

- Please reply-all with Teresa Wong (security) and a primary infra contact so we can schedule the intake call.
- I attached the intake form (mld-intake-form.pdf) — please complete the HSM vendor contact + KMS details.
- Proposed SE slots next week: Tue 11/24 10:00–10:45am PT or Wed 11/25 1:00–1:45pm PT. Let me know which works and I'll send calendar invites.

We'll prepare an architecture draft by Dec 1 and a cost comparison (Dedicated vs Private) with timeline. If HSM is confirmed required, we'll bias the recommendation toward Private but show a Dedicated+KMS-peering option and the delta.

Best,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
